description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate, a widget for rendering a quick-create button in a subpanel within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods to generate HTML forms for creating new related records, handling relationships, and managing form data for different modules.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton to provide a quick create button in subpanels, with methods to generate forms and resolve relationships.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for the quick create button, including hidden inputs for necessary context and parameters.

methods.name: get_subpanel_relationship_name
methods.description: Determines the name of the relationship associated with the subpanel, based on the subpanel definition and data source.
